newsitem.title: USA: AHI, FPA set date for merger vote.
newsitem.headline: AHI, FPA set date for merger vote.

text.p: AHI Healthcare Systems Inc and FPA Medical Management on Friday announced record and shareholder meeting dates for respective votes on the companies' proposed merger.
The record date for AHI Healthcare is February 7, and the record date for FPA Medical Management is Feb 13.

Both meetings will take place on March 17 at 1000 PST/1300 EST AHI Healthcare Systems' stockholders will meet at the Renaissance Hotel in Long Beach, California and FPA Medical Management's stockholders will meet at FPA's corporate headquarters in San Diego, California.
